title: micromatch stack: locate why numeric brace ranges miss numbers
prompt: packages/ holds a slice of the micromatch dependency tree (micromatch, picomatch, braces, fill-range, to-regex-range, is-number), resolved by plain Node with NODE_PATH=packages. Numeric brace ranges compiled to a regular expression are wrong: `require('braces')('{1..20}', { toRegex: true })` gives `['(1|20)']` instead of `['([1-9]|1[0-9]|20)']`, so the regex only matches 1 and 20, and `micromatch.braces('{1..20}', { toRegex: true })` and `to-regex-range` itself have the same problem for many ranges (5..123, 1..100, 45..1005). Find which package really causes it by following the call chain from braces down, and fix it with a minimal change.
